title: Electromagnetism
intro: The study of electromagnetism unifies the discrete forces of electricity and magnetism into a single, Lorentz-covariant field theory that governs the interaction of matter and radiation. From the static potential landscapes of Gauss and Laplace to the dynamic retarded potentials of Liénard and Wiechert, this roadmap navigates the foundational axioms, conservation laws, and relativistic symmetries of the electromagnetic manifold.
content: The study of electromagnetism unifies the discrete forces of electricity and magnetism into a single, Lorentz-covariant field theory that governs the interaction of matter and radiation. From the static potential landscapes of Gauss and Laplace to the dynamic retarded potentials of Liénard and Wiechert, this roadmap navigates the foundational axioms, conservation laws, and relativistic symmetries of the electromagnetic manifold.

bridges.classical-mechanics: Electromagnetism introduces field-mediated forces that extend the Newtonian particle paradigm, providing the basis for the Lorentz force law.
bridges.relativity: The manifest covariance of Maxwell's equations necessitated the transition from Galilean space to the Minkowski manifold of special relativity.
bridges.quantum-physics: Quantum electrodynamics (QED) quantizes the electromagnetic field, describing interactions through the exchange of virtual photons.

pillars.title: 1. Electrostatics & Potential Theory
pillars.narrative: Stationary charge distributions define scalar potential fields governed by the Poisson and Laplace equations.

pillars.title: 2. Magnetostatics & Matter
pillars.narrative: Steady currents generate solenoidal magnetic fields, while atomic-scale currents drive the macroscopic magnetization of matter.

pillars.title: 3. Electrodynamics
pillars.narrative: Time-varying fields induce electromotive forces, leading to the full synthesis of Maxwell's equations.

pillars.title: 4. Conservation Laws & Waves
pillars.narrative: The electromagnetic field acts as a dynamical repository for energy and momentum, propagating through the vacuum as transverse waves.

pillars.title: 5. Relativistic Electromagnetism
pillars.narrative: Electromagnetism is inherently relativistic, expressed via covariant tensors and 4-vectors on the Minkowski manifold.

pillars.title: 6. Radiation & Scattering
pillars.narrative: Accelerating charges generate retarded potentials and the outward flux of electromagnetic radiation.
